sources.title: Competition problem and format
claims: Single float32 band, confidence [0,1], same CRS/grid/bounds, null/NaN outside.
300m triangular distance kernel; alpha0.2/beta0.8; FN=|G|-TP.
sources.limits: The template contains catalogue positives despite the description of total absence; grid/footprint are verified from bytes.

sources.title: Known-fault scoring clarification
claims: Known pixels are masked in both rounds; pixel-exact training-label mask.
Near-known predictions can be penalized; new truth can be within300m of known traces.
sources.limits: Our local masking drops visible predictions entirely; private evaluator implementation is not inspected.

sources.title: What counts as a new fault
claims: Any fault pixel not already captured by USGS/INGENIOUS can count; newly mapped geometry of an existing system is included.
sources.limits: Does not identify hidden truth or validate any particular prediction.

sources.title: Test-source disclosure boundary
claims: Organizers are not sharing further test-source/fault-type/coverage details.
Phase2 expert review updates the test set.
sources.limits: Do not claim all hidden faults are scarpless, geothermal, or near known tips.

claims: Allowance resets on a rolling window, not a fixed calendar date/time.
sources.limits: Three per week comes from the rules; whether a rejected upload consumes allowance was not verified.

sources.title: INGENIOUS compilation and thermal archive
sources.publisher: DOE GDR; Ayling, Bridget, et al. (2022), GBCGE/NBMG/UNR
claims: DOI10.15121/1881483; CC-BY4; redistribution with attribution.
Includes shallow2m probes and paleo-hydrothermal features.
sources.limits: Archive staged by an earlier GitHub runner; hashes and local footprint/attributes rechecked this session. Availability of other listed layers does not imply they are staged.

sources.title: DOE-funded shallow thermal methods and limits
claims: Shallow2m surveys can delineate some steam-heated fault zones; seasonal adjustment used control stations.
Solar effects, hard substrates and shallow groundwater can obscure/mislead the thermal signal.
sources.limits: Supports testing a mechanism, not R15 performance or a geological discovery. McGee Mountain itself is outside our competition latitude bounds.

sources.title: GeoDAWN airborne data
claims: Radiometry informs surface geology/soil composition; magnetics informs subsurface geology/structure.
Survey flight height/line spacing vary; 100m raster sampling is not uniform100m geological information resolution.
sources.limits: Local8-bit derivatives are pinned mirrors, not the original native full-precision grids.

sources.title: Great Basin geothermal structural inventory
sources.publisher: DOE OSTI / University of Nevada; Faulds (2013)
claims: 426 systems studied; settings determined for more than240.
Fault tips, stepovers, intersections, accommodation and transfer zones are structural classes.
sources.limits: Structural setting of a geothermal system is not proof every raster-ridge junction is permeable.

sources.limits: Notebook downloaded/read; model not trained here. Its random patch CV is not our blocked validation.
